# SMuFL codepoint

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:smuflCodepoint`](gmeow-smuflCodepoint.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/smuflCodepoint>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/notation`](../../slices/notation.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A Unicode codepoint reference in the Standard Music Font Layout (SMuFL) specification that identifies a glyph used by this notation system. Multiple codepoints may be asserted as multiple triples.

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:NotationSystem`](../classes/gmeow-NotationSystem.md) -> [`xsd:string`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:smuflCodepoint`](gmeow-smuflCodepoint.md) from [`gmeow:NotationSystem`](../classes/gmeow-NotationSystem.md) to [`xsd:string`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:NotationSystem`](../classes/gmeow-NotationSystem.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record the SMuFL Unicode codepoint(s) for glyphs a music notation system uses, so a renderer can map canonical content to concrete font glyphs; assert several as several triples.

### Avoid when

- Avoid using it for non-SMuFL or non-musical glyph references and avoid treating a single triple as exhaustive — a notation system carries many codepoints, one per glyph.

### How to use

- Attach each SMuFL codepoint string (e.g. "U+E050") to the [`gmeow:NotationSystem`](../classes/gmeow-NotationSystem.md) via [`gmeow:smuflCodepoint`](gmeow-smuflCodepoint.md); repeat the triple for each glyph the system uses.

### Examples

- ex:westernStaff [`gmeow:smuflCodepoint`](gmeow-smuflCodepoint.md) "U+E050".
